title: Strata Data Conference
subtitle: September 25 - 28 | New York
summary:
Find the Anaconda booth at Strata Data Conference in New York, September 25-28! We'll have exclusive swag, new demos, and plenty of surprises, so be sure to stop by. 

Dask core developer Matt Rocklin and Data Scientist Ben Zaitlen will be hosting their tutorial 'Scaling Python Data Analysis' on Tuesday, September 26, from 9AM-12:30PM. Matt Rocklin will also give a talk 'Dask: Flexible Parallelism in Python for Advanced Analytics' on Wednesday, September 27, from 2:55-3:35PM. Co-founder and CTO Peter Wang will also be giving a talk 'Data Science Beyond the Sandbox' on Wednesday, September 27, from 4:35-5:15PM. See the full Strata Data Conference schedule here.

title: Anaconda Happy Hour
subtitle: July 13 | Austin
summary:
Join us at the Anaconda HQ in Austin, TX for a Happy Hour! We'll have Anaconda swag, games, food, drinks, plus the opportunity to talk open source, data science and more with our developers. Plus, meet our co-founders, Chief Data Scientist Travis Oliphant and CTO Peter Wang.

The Happy Hour will be in the Chase Tower on the 15th Floor, Suite 1550. We will be providing appetizers and a variety of local beverages.

title: SciPy
subtitle: July 10-16 | Austin
summary:
Continuum Analytics is sponsoring SciPy 2017 in our hometown of Austin, Texas. Come join us at the 16th annual SciPy Conference for Data Science, Python, Open Source and more! Catch tutorials and talks from core developers of Dask, Bokeh, Spyder, Jupyter and more! See the full SciPy agenda here. 

Follow us @ContinuumIO and the #SciPy2017 hashtag for updates!

title: PyCon
subtitle: May 17 - 25 | Portland
summary: Catch a talk from Dask core contributor Matt Rocklin and a tutorial from Matt and Data Scientist Ben Zaitlen at PyCon! Matt and Ben will lead the Parallel Data Analysis tutorial on Thursday, May 18, from 1:20-4:40PM, and Matt will present his talk, Dask: A Pythonic Distributed Data Science Framework, on Friday, May 19, from 4:15-5PM. Computational Scientist Ian Stokes-Rees will also present two Workshops at PyCon: Data Science Apps with Anaconda on Thursday, May 18 from 11AM-12:30PM and Accelerating your Python Data Science Code with Dask & Numba on Thursday, May 18 from 1:30-3PM.

title: GPU Technology Conference
subtitle: May 8-11 | San Jose
summary: Catch labs and talks from co-founder and CTO Peter Wang, Director of Community Innovation Stanley Seibert and Software Developer Siu Kwan Lam at the GPU Tech conference. Peter and Stanley will present their talk Harnessing the Power of Anaconda for Scalable Open Data Science on Monday, May 8, from 3-3:50PM, and Stanley and Siu will present their lab CUDA Programming in Python with Numba on Wednesday, May 10, from 2-4PM.
